title: Nine Inches of Weaving
subtitle: 布料与织物 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 布料与织物（生活与学习·服饰与手工）
meta: 主题语境：布料与织物（生活与学习·服饰与手工）　|　核心词汇：cloth　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cloth 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 my mother was sent to weave ① cloth she could not afford, and she said the weaving was the whole of the lesson. The ② cloth, meaning the material and not the garment, was nine inches wide and was woven by whoever came last; cloth, she said, is the only thing on a loom that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cloth on that loom had the same thread, and the ④ cloth at the end, meaning the one the weaver kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever wove properly. Cloth, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cloth was the whole of the winter, meaning the warmth it carried and not the material. The ⑥ cloth, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a winter that everybody wants and nobody questions; cloth, he said, is either something you weave or the only word that means both a material and warmth. She said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ cloth had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the thread. The ⑧ cloth of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine inches and eleven years of weaving; cloth, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cloth I remember is the one at the end, which was woven in 1965 and is still described as the finest in the county. A ⑩ cloth, my grandmother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being woven; every cloth, she said, is warmth that has agreed to look like a material. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 布料（指那块料子本身，与那件衣服相对）
C. 固定搭配：weave cloth 织布
D. n. 布料（指那台织机上每一块）
E. n. 布料（指末尾那一块）
F. n. 温暖（抽象：它带来的那份暖意）
G. n. 那份暖意（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The cloth, meaning the material and not the garment
cloth was the whole of the winter
the cloth had become a number in a report
The cloth of the whole thing
A cloth, my grandmother said in 1970

answers.why: weave cloth 意为“织布”，1945 年母亲被派去织她买不起的那种布。
cloth 意为“布、布料”，指那块料子本身而不是那件衣服，宽九英寸，由最后来的人织。
cloth 指那台织机上每一块布，每一块都是同样的线。
cloth 指末尾那一块（织匠保留的那一块），是唯一有人认真织过的。
cloth 意为“温暖”，抽象指它带来的那份暖意，父亲说 cloth 就是那个冬天的全部。
cloth 为抽象用法，指那份暖意本身，是一个冬天里人人都想要、却没人质疑的东西。
cloth 意为“布、布料”，到 1960 年这块 cloth 成了报告里的一个数字。
cloth 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英寸和十一年的织造。
cloth 意为“布料”，我记得的是末尾那一块，1965 年织成，至今仍被说成全县最细的。
cloth 为抽象总称，祖母说一块布料是唯一会因为被认真织造而变好的东西。

那块布，指的是那块料子本身而不是那件衣服，宽九英寸，由最后来的人织。（cloth）

answers: In 1945 my mother was sent to weave cloth she could not afford, and she said the weaving was the whole of the lesson.
The cloth, meaning the material and not the garment, was nine inches wide and was woven by whoever came last.
Every cloth on that loom had the same thread.
The cloth at the end, meaning the one the weaver kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever wove properly.
My father said cloth was the whole of the winter, meaning the warmth it carried and not the material.
A cloth, my grandmother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being woven.
